verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a single persistent dot that keeps its own notes about preferences, decisions, and ongoing work, and keeps the same memory across ChatGPT, Slack, Teams, and calls. Nothing documents grouping related chats and files into a project or space with shared context and instructions. Persistent agent memory is an adjacent capability, not the project/space organization this story asks for.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can organize related chats and files into a project or space that shares context and instructions

citations.quote: It also keeps its own notes about preferences, decisions, and ongoing work so it can use them in later conversations.
Changing where you talk to it doesn't start a new dot or reset its memory.
